# GNK ASG Autonomous System — 3-hour activation runbook

Status: locked preparation. This file is not part of the public portal build.

## Goal

Use the 3-hour session with the director at the computer to connect accounts, review generated drafts and activate only complete, tested modules.

## Core rule

Nothing becomes publicly visible unless it passes the final activation checklist. The portal remains the primary source; external networks distribute links back to the portal.

## Hour 1 — Mail and calendar foundation

1. Confirm domain mail provider and create the public mailbox `info@gnk-asg.hr`.
2. Create or confirm the agent sender mailbox: `assistant@gnk-asg.hr` or `desk@gnk-asg.hr`.
3. Confirm whether `press@gnk-asg.hr`, `publish@gnk-asg.hr`, `social@gnk-asg.hr` and `alerts@gnk-asg.hr` are real mailboxes or aliases.
4. Confirm signature language: Croatian, English or automatic by sender language.
5. Connect mailbox access only through official provider settings.
6. Connect private calendar only for availability/free-busy testing first.
7. Test draft-only reply mode.
8. Test one internal dummy calendar event.

## Hour 2 — Portal publishing and dashboard

1. Review autonomous publishing policy.
2. Review allowed and blocked topic groups.
3. Generate one test English Insight article.
4. Review title, 300+ words, disclosure, SEO and image.
5. Confirm whether the article is published or kept as draft.
6. Review the publishing dashboard plan.
7. Confirm what appears publicly and what stays internal.
8. Confirm whether daily publishing starts as manual trigger or scheduled.

## Hour 3 — YouTube, Facebook and LinkedIn preparation

Priority order: YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn.

### YouTube

1. Create or confirm the official channel / Brand Account.
2. Confirm channel name: recommended `GNK ASG Insights`.
3. Confirm logo, banner and channel description.
4. Prepare first weekly video brief package: title, script, thumbnail, description and tags.
5. Decide initial mode: draft/private first or scheduled public after review.

### Facebook

1. Confirm official page.
2. Confirm administrator access.
3. Confirm tone for short public posts.
4. Prepare draft post from the test Insight article.

### LinkedIn

1. Confirm company page.
2. Decide whether personal profile sharing remains manual.
3. Confirm standard hashtags.
4. Prepare business-style post from the test Insight article.

## Final activation checklist

- No public route is empty.
- No button points to a dead URL.
- No external channel is marked active before connection.
- No sensitive topic is allowed for automatic publication.
- Mail agent is in draft-only mode before live replies.
- Calendar access is free-busy only before event creation.
- Test article has title, meta description, canonical, image and schema.
- Test image has proper file name and alt text.
- Dashboard shows the current mode accurately.
- Public activation remains false until explicit final approval.

## Recommended initial live mode

- Portal Insights: manual trigger first.
- Mail agent: draft-only first.
- Calendar: free-busy only first.
- YouTube: weekly draft first.
- Facebook: draft post first.
- LinkedIn: draft post first.

After 7 days of stable results, scheduled publication can be enabled module by module.
